question: Should experimental Claws adopt `CLAW.md` as the canonical exported package manifest after the consented lifecycle stack lands, while retaining grouped JSON as accepted input?
rationale: This is a new user-facing package-format and export convention; the technical adapter can be correct while the permanent authoring and compatibility direction still requires explicit maintainer ownership.

options.title: Sponsor the format after stack proof
options.body: Accept `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export only after the base lifecycle stack and a final-head round-trip proof are reviewed.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical for now
options.body: Retain grouped JSON as the canonical export artifact and defer Markdown authoring until the RFC or package-distribution direction is settled.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Allow `CLAW.md` as an input adapter but postpone changing export output until consumers and lifecycle behavior are established.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the format after stack proof
recommendation.body: Accept `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export only after the base lifecycle stack and a final-head round-trip proof are reviewed.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest demonstrated connection to the current and previous Claws manifest-format implementation, though final product acceptance remains a broader maintainer decision.
